profile.bio: AI Engineer with 3 years of experience building and deploying production Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Computer Vision solutions. Specializing in autonomous multi-agent workflows with LangGraph, enterprise RAG platforms with ChromaDB and pgvector, real-time interview proctoring with OpenCV and MediaPipe, and automated LLMOps evaluation suites. Adept at bridging state-of-the-art foundation models (Gemini, Claude, GPT-4o) with resilient full-stack systems to solve high-impact business problems.

Built a meeting bot that automatically joins Google Meet, Teams, and Zoom interviews to detect deepfake faces, cloned voices, and liveness bypass attacks in real time.

Collected, curated, and balanced multimodal datasets for deepfake and lip-sync models, applying data augmentation to ensure high accuracy on real-world video.

projects.title: SalesRocks — Enterprise AI Sales Platform
projects.subtitle: RAG · Generative AI · AI Agents

highlights: Ask AI (Enterprise RAG): contextual question-answering across sales calls, emails, leads, and CRM records using Gemini embeddings and PostgreSQL + pgvector with source attribution and follow-up suggestions

Do AI (Autonomous Multi-Agent): built with LangGraph and tool calling to plan multi-step sales actions (lead scoring, email drafting, deal updates) requiring explicit human confirmation before execution
Safe AI & Evals: dual Zod schema validation, PII masking before inference, audit trails, and an automated LLM evaluation suite of 32 benchmark checks + 10 system invariant tests

Resilient multi-model gateway: automated fallback routing between Google Gemini and Anthropic Claude APIs to guarantee 99.9% availability

projects.title: Meeting Bot — Deepfake Guardian
projects.subtitle: Real-time AI interview proctoring
projects.description: An autonomous interview monitoring bot that joins Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom calls in real time to detect synthetic faces, cloned audio, and liveness bypass attacks.
highlights: Autonomous meeting integration: headless bot that automatically joins scheduled video interviews across Google Meet, Zoom, and Teams to intercept live video/audio feeds
Deepfake & voice anti-spoofing: analyzes video frames and audio spectral patterns for face swaps, puppet attacks, lip desync, and cloned voices using deep learning models
Pluggable detector microservices: asynchronous frame-routing pipeline streaming to detector servers with local TensorFlow.js and audio heuristics fallback
Live proctoring dashboard: real-time threat telemetry, per-participant risk scores, forensic timeline markers, and instant cheating alerts

projects.title: Live Eye Tracking & Lip-Sync Detection
projects.subtitle: Real-time AI interview proctoring
projects.description: A computer vision proctoring engine that performs real-time iris-gaze tracking and audio-visual lip-sync verification during live interviews, capturing timestamped video proof for security audits.
highlights: Real-time gaze & iris tracking: tracks 3D iris position and facial landmarks via Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe to detect candidate look-aways, screen switching, or off-screen cheating
Audio-visual lip-sync verification: correlates lip motion landmarks against audio phonemes to detect proxy interviewers, lip dubbing, or pre-recorded audio feeds
Automated video evidence capture: triggers automatic recording and archival of short, timestamped video proof clips whenever anomaly thresholds are breached
Dataset curation & class balancing: collected, augmented, and balanced face, video, and audio datasets to maximize detection accuracy across diverse real-world lighting and accents
Zero-install clientless pipeline: runs low-latency inference over browser WebRTC streams with zero software installation required on the candidate's machine

projects.title: Vision Agent — Multi-Modal AI Assistant
projects.subtitle: Multi-Modal AI Agent · 13 AI Vision Tools
projects.description: An autonomous multi-modal AI agent that ingests images and high-resolution video streams to reason, inspect, and answer complex visual queries in natural language.
highlights: 13 specialized AI vision tools: seamlessly integrates YOLO11 object detection, RapidOCR text recognition, OpenCV YuNet face detection, scene classification, and optical flow tracking
Agentic tool routing & orchestration: dynamically decides and executes tool chains using LangGraph, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, and Gemini API via function calling
Asynchronous video processing: implements adaptive frame sampling and background processing queues to analyze long video streams with low latency
Interactive visual frontend: built with Next.js and FastAPI for real-time bounding box annotations, OCR text overlays, and conversational multi-turn Q&A

projects.title: Autonomous AI Research Agent

projects.title: AI Electricity Prediction & Energy Assistant
